author: reek
body: H11: the Narrator role collapses a definition's Rationale, Discovery, and Doctrine annotations into a plain-language summary block. Skips Warning/Invariant/Todo (those are actionable signals, not narration) and Discussion (that's for the Discussion chapter).

author: reek
body: The Reader uses Narrator output as a "what this is" preamble above the H1 inline bubble. Empty inputs yield empty output.

author: reek
body: Output as four sections (Why / Found / Rule / blank trailer) with a heading per section. Sections with no entries are omitted entirely.

author: reek
body: D.8: brief() collapses by kind and emits a one-liner. Used by list views and search summaries.
